text.tspan: Billy Snedden was an Australian politician who served as the
leader of the Liberal Party from 1972 to 1975. Snedden was
ﬁrst elected to the Australian Parliament in 1955 and became
the youngest member of an Australian Cabinet in history …
Billy Snedden was an Australian politician. Born in Perth in
1926, Snedden studied law before entering politics. He was
elected to the Australian Parliament in 1955 and retired from
politics in 1983, and passed away in 1987 …
